newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil, Idemitsu to fortify distribution ties.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil, Idemitsu to fortify distribution ties.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Friday it will supply oil products to Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd when Idemitsu's Hyogo refinery shuts for routine maintenance checks this summer, strengthening their distribution ties.

Although the two firms have already started cooperating in domestic distribution in Japan's northern island of Hokkaido and the Tokyo area, this will be the first time that Nippon Oil has supplied oil products to Idemitsu's Hyogo refinery in western Japan.

The supplies are expected to be shipped from a refinery belonging to Koa Oil Co Ltd in the Nippon oil group. This could be either Koa Oil's Osaka refinery or its Marifu refinery, a Nippon Oil spokesman said.

Last year, Nippon Oil and Idemitsu refineries, when closed for a turnaround, received oil supplies from each other's nearby plants rather than from refineries within their own group, which are sometimes located far away, in an effort to cut transportation costs.
